scope.parity: Fresh final-source CLI test at 512/8192 compares independent old/journal histories with the same seeded rows and exactTokenizer. scope.selection: Existing raw-human speaker aggregates select the cut along row-tree depth. Three selected queries at 40/4000 rows read 4/8 times; cold build, pin setup, media passes, conversion, callback/recording work and whole-operation reads excluded. Existing caches cap charged bytes at 65536; observed selected cache sizes 0/104/0. No payload scan, format change or new persistent fact family.
scope.lifetime: CLI 512/8192 outputs 510/8190, samples 3/63, live peak one and final zero under unchanged bound two. Original Agent lifetime and >9MiB values rerun unchanged. New CLI >9MiB value compares all 9*1024*1024+17 characters in live and replayed durable histories. WeakRefs do not establish retained heap or aggregate cache/pin capacity.
scope.faults: Clear/restore producer, client finalization, UI notification and mirror acknowledgement preserve exact cause, tokens/offset/range/cache anchor, live and replayed durable values, then permit same-writer continuation. Source, abort, journal preparation, token notification and recording flush preserve original cause and state. Independent primary/compensation/release failures retain ordered object references. Release drains later references after one failure. A lone post-publication release failure rejects with its original object while the acknowledged cut remains published.
scope.closeIdentity: Unchanged #3919 readerLifetime 11 tests/29 assertions and readerCleanup 3/20 pass. No close-identity assertion changed and no descriptor reopen fallback added.
scope.media: CLI clear/restore compensation holds removed immutable blobs without a copied history snapshot. Actual media ownership-index and reservation/store replacement/lock files are observed and classified, not denied or called eliminated. Two metadata/reference passes remain linear. No snapshot/candidate dump file; non-media CLI tests deny all operation creation across roots.
scope.pendingMedia: Actual pinned checkpoint and current-row RequestMediaResolver hold request-only reservation plus instance lease across concurrent clear at 3/64/65, janitor, completion or exact-cause abort. Original bytes/old pinned rows survive; awaited release permits collection. Consumer harness is below provider preparation, not a full public ChatSession/provider transport proof, unread-media protection or shared provider reservation migration.
scope.freshAndReuse: All 43 accepted files and 12 gates completed with the exact final 9051-file digest, including pre-commit checkpoint runs with the same bytes. Existing completed runs are reused without rerunning the matrix after byte-equal controls. No earlier mismatching receipt is counted. Original 5000-case normalization oracle and Agent owner/512/8192/>9MiB regressions ran fresh in this matrix. Historical 45000 provider references and public-chat RED are not rerun or relabeled fresh.
